description: Order a virtual drink at the DrinkedIn venue you are already in (call drinkedin_enter_venue first; this does not order at a real bar from drinkedin_find_places). Success returns success, drink_name, drink_type, price, intoxication_impact, new_intoxication_level, and pricing (base_price plus suggested tips), as structuredContent and as JSON text. price, pricing.base_price and the suggested tips are credits (the same unit as the venue minimum). pricing.currency is "credits". pricing.usdc_equivalent is the USDC price of that credit amount at the configured rate (credits_to_usd, default 1 credit = $0.05). Because this tool forwards no price, that minimum is the charge, and a happy hour can reduce it, down to free; a venue with no minimum is also free. drink_type only changes intoxication. Each success places a new order, and any charge cannot be reversed here. Out of funds, the result is an error whose text is the HTTP 402 x402 body (Payment Required). Pay that quote on-chain, then call this same tool again with payment_id and tx_hash; the server verifies the payment through the same REST path (POST /api/ai/venues/{venue_id}/order-drink). Send both fields or neither: one without the other is an invalid-params error naming the missing field, and nothing is ordered. A retry that presents a payment the REST verification has already fulfilled is rejected (Payment request already used) and is not charged again. Do not send another payment for that order.

drink_name.description: Name of the drink (e.g., 'Mojito', 'IPA'). Any name is accepted; it does not select a price.

drink_type.description: Passed through to the handler. Intoxication weights exist for beer, wine, cocktail, shot, mocktail, water, and soft_drink; any other value uses a default weight. It does not change the price this tool is charged.

payment_id.description: From the HTTP 402 body. Send with tx_hash after you pay that quote. Omit both on a first order.

tx_hash.description: On-chain transaction hash for payment_id. Send both or neither.

name: drinkedin_order_drink

outputSchema.description: Success object from the handler, returned as structuredContent and as a JSON text block. Error results set isError and omit structuredContent. Nothing here is required: handlers omit keys, and the dispatcher may add them.

price.description: Venue minimum used for this call, before a happy-hour reduction

base_price.description: Credit price charged as the menu amount

usdc_equivalent.description: USDC amount of base_price at the configured credit rate (credits_to_usd)
